cards.definition: A warning or condition that qualifies a statement (चेतावनी / शर्त)
cards.exampleSentence: One caveat is that this only works for files under 1 GB.

cards.definition: A statement limiting responsibility or certainty (अस्वीकरण)
cards.exampleSentence: A quick disclaimer: this is based on partial data.

cards.definition: A subtle difference in meaning or detail (सूक्ष्म अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: There's a nuance in how vendors define a corrected price.

cards.definition: A likely consequence or effect (निहितार्थ)
cards.exampleSentence: What are the implications for downstream reports?

cards.definition: A complicating consequence of an action (जटिल परिणाम)
cards.exampleSentence: The ramifications of changing the key are significant.

cards.definition: An unintended consequence, usually negative (दुष्परिणाम)
cards.exampleSentence: Skipping validation had serious repercussions.

cards.definition: Action taken to reduce harm or risk (जोखिम घटाने की कार्रवाई)
cards.exampleSentence: The mitigation plan includes automatic retries.

cards.definition: A plan for use if something goes wrong (आपात योजना)
cards.exampleSentence: We need a contingency plan if the vendor misses the deadline.

cards.definition: An alternative to use if the main option fails (विकल्प / वैकल्पिक व्यवस्था)
cards.exampleSentence: The fallback is to load yesterday's file.

cards.definition: A measure that protects against harm (सुरक्षा उपाय)
cards.exampleSentence: Validation acts as a safeguard against corrupt data.

cards.definition: A hidden danger or common mistake (छुपा हुआ ख़तरा)
cards.exampleSentence: A common pitfall is ignoring time zones.

cards.definition: An unexpected catch or hidden difficulty (अनपेक्षित अड़चन)
cards.exampleSentence: Here's a gotcha: the vendor timestamps are in local time.

cards.definition: An advance warning (पूर्व सूचना)
cards.exampleSentence: Just a heads-up that the file will arrive late tonight.

cards.definition: For your information, a note shared without needing action (आपकी जानकारी के लिए)
cards.exampleSentence: FYI, the deployment window moved to Saturday.

cards.definition: Estimated time of arrival or completion (अनुमानित पूर्णता समय)
cards.exampleSentence: What's your ETA on the bug fix?

cards.definition: End of day (दिन का अंत)
cards.exampleSentence: I'll send the summary by EOD.

cards.definition: A very short summary of a long text (संक्षेप में)
cards.exampleSentence: TL;DR, we need two more weeks to finish safely.

cards.definition: A point of contact or interaction (संपर्क बिंदु)
cards.exampleSentence: We have a weekly touchpoint with the vendor.

cards.definition: A regular rhythm or frequency of events (नियमित अंतराल / लय)
cards.exampleSentence: Let's set a fortnightly cadence for reviews.

cards.definition: A team meeting to reflect on what went well and what didn't (कार्य-समीक्षा बैठक)
cards.exampleSentence: The retrospective surfaced the same communication gaps.

cards.definition: A specific task assigned during a meeting (बैठक में तय किया गया कार्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Please capture the action items and owners.

cards.definition: A key lesson or point to remember (मुख्य निष्कर्ष)
cards.exampleSentence: My main takeaway is that we need earlier testing.

cards.definition: A list of topics to be discussed (चर्चा-सूची)
cards.exampleSentence: Please add this to the agenda for tomorrow.

cards.definition: A place to note off-topic items for later discussion (बाद में चर्चा के लिए रखे गए विषय)
cards.exampleSentence: Let's put that in the parking lot and return to it later.

cards.definition: An in-depth examination of a topic (गहन अध्ययन)
cards.exampleSentence: We scheduled a deep dive into the retry logic.

cards.definition: Explaining ideas visually on a board (बोर्ड पर चित्र बनाकर समझाना)
cards.exampleSentence: The whiteboarding session clarified the data flow.

cards.definition: A quick test to confirm something is reasonable (त्वरित तर्कसंगतता जाँच)
cards.exampleSentence: Run a sanity check on the totals before sending.

cards.definition: A basic test to confirm the system starts and works (बुनियादी कार्यक्षमता जाँच)
cards.exampleSentence: The smoke test failed right after deployment.

cards.definition: A rehearsal without real effects (बिना असर वाला अभ्यास)
cards.exampleSentence: Do a dry run of the migration first.

cards.definition: A small demonstration that an idea is feasible (विचार की व्यवहार्यता का प्रदर्शन)
cards.exampleSentence: We built a proof of concept in two days.

cards.definition: The degree to which something can be done (व्यवहार्यता)
cards.exampleSentence: We are assessing the feasibility of real-time ingestion.

cards.definition: The ability to work successfully (व्यवहार्यता / टिकाऊपन)
cards.exampleSentence: The pilot confirmed the viability of the approach.

cards.definition: A short daily team meeting to share progress and blockers (रोज़ की संक्षिप्त टीम बैठक)
cards.exampleSentence: Keep your update in the stand-up under a minute.

cards.definition: A fixed period in which a team completes planned work (निर्धारित अवधि का कार्य-चक्र)
cards.exampleSentence: We committed to twelve tickets this sprint.

cards.definition: The amount of work a team completes in a sprint (टीम की कार्य-गति)
cards.exampleSentence: Our velocity dropped after two engineers left.

cards.definition: Units used to estimate the effort of a task (कार्य के प्रयास की अनुमान इकाई)
cards.exampleSentence: We estimated the feature at eight story points.

cards.definition: Agreed criteria for a task to be considered finished (कार्य पूर्ण मानने के मानदंड)
cards.exampleSentence: Tests and documentation are part of our definition of done.

cards.definition: Conditions a feature must meet to be accepted (स्वीकृति की शर्तें)
cards.exampleSentence: Write clear acceptance criteria before development starts.

cards.definition: A chart showing remaining work over time (शेष कार्य दर्शाने वाला चार्ट)
cards.exampleSentence: The burndown shows we're behind schedule.

cards.definition: Reviewing and refining backlog items before planning (बैकलॉग की समीक्षा व परिष्कार)
cards.exampleSentence: Backlog grooming clarified the vague tickets.

cards.definition: Examination of code changes by colleagues (सहकर्मियों द्वारा कोड की समीक्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: A good code review improves both quality and learning.

cards.definition: To criticise minor details excessively (छोटी बातों पर टोकना)
cards.exampleSentence: I don't want to nitpick, but the variable name is unclear.

cards.definition: A clash between changes made to the same code (कोड बदलावों का टकराव)
cards.exampleSentence: I'll resolve the merge conflict before lunch.

cards.definition: To reapply commits on top of another base (कमिट्स को नए आधार पर दोबारा लगाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Please rebase your branch on the latest main.

cards.definition: Two developers working together on the same code (दो डेवलपर्स का साथ में कोडिंग करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Pair programming helped the new joiner learn quickly.

cards.definition: Available to respond to urgent issues outside work hours (आपात स्थिति के लिए उपलब्ध)
cards.exampleSentence: I'm on-call this weekend.

cards.definition: The person leading the response to an incident (घटना संभालने वाला नेतृत्वकर्ता)
cards.exampleSentence: The incident commander assigned roles within minutes.

cards.definition: A dedicated space or channel for handling a crisis (संकट संभालने का विशेष कक्ष)
cards.exampleSentence: We opened a war room for the production outage.
